Module Contents#

class paidiverpy.open_layer.open_layer.OpenLayer(config_file_path: str | None = None, input_path: str | None = None, output_path: str | None = None, metadata_path: str | None = None, metadata_type: str | None = None, metadata: paidiverpy.metadata_parser.MetadataParser = None, config: paidiverpy.config.config.Configuration = None, logger: logging.Logger | None = None, images: paidiverpy.images_layer.ImagesLayer = None, paidiverpy: paidiverpy.Paidiverpy = None, step_name: str = 'raw', parameters: dict | None = None, raise_error: bool = False, verbose: int = 2, track_changes: bool = True, n_jobs: int = 1)[source]#

Bases: paidiverpy.Paidiverpy

Open raw image file.

Parameters:

  • config_file_path (str) – The path to the configuration file.

  • input_path (str) – The path to the input files.

  • output_path (str) – The path to the output files.

  • metadata_path (str) – The path to the metadata file.

  • metadata_type (str) – The type of the metadata file.

  • metadata (MetadataParser) – The metadata object.

  • config (Configuration) – The configuration object.

  • logger (logging.Logger) – The logger object.

  • images (ImagesLayer) – The images object.

  • paidiverpy (Paidiverpy) – The paidiverpy object.

  • step_name (str) – The name of the step.

  • parameters (dict) – The parameters for the step.

  • raise_error (bool) – Whether to raise an error.

  • verbose (int) – verbose level (0 = none, 1 = errors/warnings, 2 = info).

  • track_changes (bool) – Whether to track changes. Defaults to True.

  • n_jobs (int) – The number of jobs to run in parallel.
